backup.production_rule: Phase is backfill, not expand, only because the expand-safety scan refuses the literal DELETE FROM inside prune_api_usage_v1 (a new function that deletes telemetry older than 120 days only when called; nothing runs it at apply time). Two new tables (llm_usage, api_budget_snapshots; RLS on, no policy, service_role select/insert only), three new functions (api_usage_daily_v1, api_budget_daily_v1, prune_api_usage_v1; security definer, service_role execute only), one new app_settings row (api_caps, insert on conflict do nothing), and apply_verifier_run_v1 replaced by its live body with V14-V18 added to the daily scope array and V14-V15 to the hourly one (live md5(prosrc) 5c02101b0c2bd109389ce659702b2270 equals the repo definition in 20260925010000, read 2026-10-04). No existing data, table or grant changes. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: service_role_only_tables
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(c.relrowsecurity) and not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('llm_usage','api_budget_snapshots')) and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.llm_usage','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.llm_usage','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.api_budget_snapshots','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.api_budget_snapshots','select') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.llm_usage','insert') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.api_budget_snapshots','insert') from pg_class c where c.oid in ('public.llm_usage'::regclass, 'public.api_budget_snapshots'::regclass)

forward_verification.name: functions_service_role_only_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.api_usage_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.api_budget_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.prune_api_usage_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.api_usage_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.api_usage_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.api_budget_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.api_budget_daily_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.prune_api_usage_v1(integer)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.prune_api_usage_v1(integer)','execute') and (select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('api_usage_daily_v1','api_budget_daily_v1','prune_api_usage_v1'))

forward_verification.name: daily_scope_names_v14_to_v18_hourly_v14_v15
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%''V13'',''V14'',''V15'',''V16'',''V17'',''V18''%' and prosrc like '%array[''V1'',''V2'',''V3'',''V4'',''V5'',''V7'',''V7b'',''V11'',''V12'',''V13'',''V14'',''V15'']%' from pg_proc where pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and proname = 'apply_verifier_run_v1'

forward_verification.name: api_caps_seeded_with_four_caps
forward_verification.query: select jsonb_array_length(value -> 'caps') = 4 and (value #>> '{rules,pressure_pct}') = '70' from public.app_settings where key = 'api_caps'

forward_verification.name: the_read_functions_answer
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.api_usage_daily_v1(35)) >= 0 and (select count(*) from public.api_budget_daily_v1(35)) >= 0

forward_verification.name: api_governor_heartbeat_seeded
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from public.job_heartbeats where job_name = 'api-governor' and expected_interval_seconds = 172800

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Redeploy the previous system-verifier and the functions that write llm_usage first (their inserts are advisory), then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261004_api_governor.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it restores the previous apply_verifier_run_v1 body, resolves any open V14-V18 finding, drops the three functions, the api_caps setting and both tables (the usage rows and snapshots are lost).

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE deploying the functions that insert into llm_usage / api_budget_snapshots and the system-verifier that raises V14-V18. Deploying first is safe only if every insert is advisory (logged, never thrown); a system-verifier that raises V14-V18 before the daily scope array names them would leave those findings unresolvable.
